acceptanceCriteria: --help and spec state the exact matching rule (fields, tokenization, AND/OR).
A phrase or all-terms mode exists and is tested; unrelated one-word hits are demonstrably reduced on a fixture queue.
body:
Observed 2026-10-06 while deduplicating: `corvint-tasks ticket search --label agent-memory --text WORD` returned many unrelated tickets (for example text 'refresh' returned LSP, CI and PR tickets; 'heartbeat' returned 8 mixed hits), while some exact phrases returned none. Matching semantics are undocumented. Idea: document the matching rule, add phrase/exact and ranked modes or a score so dedupe is not manual.

Source: batch 4 lanes for GitHub #641-#647, 2026-10-06 (branches claude/v1-0645-audit-outside-lock, claude/scale-tasks-v1-0893, claude/scale-core-v1-0416, claude/gh644-live-upgrade). Darwin 25.6.0, go1.27.1. Versions: corvint-tasks 0.0.0-tcp01-unverified+build.202; corvint 1.0.0-rc.2 (build 360).
title: ticket search --text matches loosely, so one-word queries return many unrelated hits
